authorization_scope: A CERTIFIED_STORAGE_POLICY pass authorizes ONLY accepting P3 as the evidence-backed design for the storage/kind-decoupling portion of future #158 implementation. It does not enable P3 in production, enable automatic admission, remove the 72h gate, change startup recall, authorize #160/#161, close #162, or constitute rollout/canary acceptance.

corpus.blindness: candidate/current outputs must not exist for certification cases before the final human corpus is frozen (reveal gate)
corpus.no_hand_curation: selection is a pure function of the snapshot, seed, and exclusion sets; candidate/current outputs are not inputs

overlap_policy.proof: derived set intersection is empty, recorded in the manifest

corpus.privacy: raw content host-local outside Git; public artifacts carry digests, aggregates, and sanitized categories only

fail_closed_events: candidate output revealed before label freeze
N != 100 without a pre-declared invalid/inconclusive run

human_labeling.inter_rater: agreement and disagreement reported by field
human_labeling.records: raw reviewer records preserved separately from adjudicated labels; no mechanical majority vote for substantive disagreement
human_labeling.reviewer_a: one full independent blind reviewer over all 100 cases
human_labeling.reviewer_b: a second independent blind reviewer for every high-consequence case and every substantive first-reviewer disagreement

uncertainty_method.description: Resample the 100 paired per-case correctness indicators with replacement; recompute current accuracy, P3 accuracy, and their difference on each resample; report the 2.5th/97.5th percentiles of the difference distribution.
uncertainty_method.name: paired_bootstrap_percentile

unknown_signal_doctrine.fabricated_fallback: any fallback fabricating evidence/source prior/taxonomy certainty invalidates the run
